component: Multiday background grid state and caller ordering

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The column creates24 row/gridcell pairs, then updates their date/time names when either the date or working hours change. The updater guards absent date/cells, clones the date for each hour and makes only the clamped first working hour tabbable. The actual setup sets hours before assigning the date, so the later setter supplies another update. The row wrappers use display:contents. No grid-keyboard navigation, rendered layout or screen-reader result was established, and the changed tests do not directly assert these names/roles.
title: Calendar hour-cell labels and the single tab entry update from both date and working-hour changes
